changeSet.sql:
-- Remove portal menu entries related to "主题域/subject domains" from navigation and menu management. -- This feature is managed inside platform pages and should not appear as a portal menu entry. WITH RECURSIVE doomed_seed AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE -- Seeded titleKey/name for the old menu entry lower(name) = 'sys.nav.portal.modelingplanningsubjectdomains' OR (metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%modelingplanningsubjectdomains%') -- Common entryKey/path variants across historical seeds/customizations OR (metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%"entrykey":"subjectdomains"%') OR lower(path) = 'subject-domains' -- Match by component when metadata/path are missing OR (component IS NOT NULL AND lower(component) LIKE '%/pages/catalog/datadomainmanagementpage%') OR (component IS NOT NULL AND lower(component) LIKE '%/pages/catalog/domainslistpage%') ), doomed AS ( SELECT id FROM doomed_seed UNION ALL SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN doomed d ON m.parent_id = d.id ) DELETE FROM portal_menu_visibility v WHERE v.menu_id IN (SELECT id FROM doomed);
WITH RECURSIVE doomed_seed AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE lower(name) = 'sys.nav.portal.modelingplanningsubjectdomains' OR (metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%modelingplanningsubjectdomains%') OR (metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(metadata) LIKE '%"entrykey":"subjectdomains"%') OR lower(path) = 'subject-domains' OR (component IS NOT NULL AND lower(component) LIKE '%/pages/catalog/datadomainmanagementpage%') OR (component IS NOT NULL AND lower(component) LIKE '%/pages/catalog/domainslistpage%') ), doomed AS ( SELECT id FROM doomed_seed UNION ALL SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN doomed d ON m.parent_id = d.id ) DELETE FROM portal_menu m WHERE m.id IN (SELECT id FROM doomed);
